column4: Quickslot storage can expand independently while the mobile interface continues to show six controls.
An invalid shortcut position no longer clears an existing valid assignment before failing.
Invalid saved shortcut positions no longer prevent the associated inventory item from loading.
Sparse extended placeholders restore through the existing save format, and malformed placement arrays no longer crash loading.
Overlapping rollback ranges are merged before classifying events, reducing repeated scans while preserving history.
Added expanded-slot, save-reference and rollback-equivalence cases, with native six-control and extended save/load checks.
Android checks use an actual slider touch and wait for rendered dialog pixels before capturing healing screenshots.
Recorded TEST100's successful tests and incomplete screenshot acceptance alongside this batch's reproductions.
I separated the six-button mobile layout from quickslot storage and protected item loading from invalid shortcut references. Rollback-heavy statistics also avoid repeated history scans.
